description.en:
Gives the player a formation and sets it as a team formation, in one call: one copy of the formation item is added to the inventory, then it is set.

Where it is set depends on the second argument:
- false (default): as team 0's formation, and also on teams 1, 2 and 3 when the third argument is true (the player's data keeps four teams);
- true: into a separate formation field of the party data instead. The shipped scripts use this form for the "ifb" formations, and "ifb" formations are the ones the 5-a-side challenge scripts line up in (for example btl0301 uses "ifb0301"), so this is most likely the challenge formation.
Nothing is set if the ID is unknown.
true to store the formation in the separate formation field (used for the "ifb" 5-a-side formations); false to set it as team 0's formation.
Only used when separateSlot is false: true to set the formation on all four teams, false for team 0 only.

true once the call has run.
false if the item system is not ready or the ID argument is not a string.
null if the engine is not ready or no argument was given.

examples.case: Setting a formation on the main team only
examples.code:
// Unlock a new 11-a-side formation and use it on team 0 only
CMND_ADD_SET_FORMATION("ifa0002");
